comment: Multi-turn: assertFakeFixtureComplete runs at the end of every turn, so turn 1 would fail on the step turn 2 still needs.

response.comment: No text at all before the tool call: the abort then leaves the turn with nothing to record, which is the case that used to strand the user message.

match.comment: 1, not 2: the aborted turn left history untouched, so this turn carries only its own message. Pre-fix history was [user('make a note'), user('second message')] and this matcher fails — the fixture error then replaces the reply, so 'second turn ok' never reaches the screen.
